blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The existence of Vice President Sara Duterte’s alleged dollar-denominated bank accounts has raised the possibility that she has additional financial assets beyond those already examined in the P817.87 million alleged unexplained wealth case, according to the House prosecution panel in her ongoing impeachment trial.
